taskGoal: Implement the V3.10 B10-B13 Windows source-independent portable runtime boundary, including standalone frontend output, build/start/stop/backup/restore/manifest/checksum scripts, Windows CI smoke coverage and direct documentation.
actualChanges: Configured Next to emit the standalone server artifact and added a release packager that assembles the Spring Boot jar, Next standalone/static/public files, jlink Java image, Node runtime, H2 runtime, scripts, manifest and checksums without putting runtime data in the install tree.

Added loopback-only release start/stop, external data-root layout and precedence, process identity/PID verification, foreign-port refusal, H2 backup/restore round-trip and current-user DPAPI smoke scripts.

Added pinned-commit Windows CI coverage for clean unpack, developer-tool-free runtime, restart, full install-tree immutability, dependency gates, Java credential/migration gates, synthetic V3.9 H2 baseline startup, backup/restore, port conflict and sensitive marker scans.
